units.source_text: 我当然是打算回到东京就去拜访先生的。

en.t: Of course, I intended to visit Sensei as soon as I returned to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 因为离开学足有两周的时间，我便想着开学前去看看先生。

en.t: Since there were still a full two weeks before classes began, I thought I would go see Sensei before the term started.

units.source_text: 可是回来之后过了两三天，在镰仓时的那种心情就渐渐淡了下来，

en.t: But after I had been back for two or three days, the feelings I had had in Kamakura gradually began to fade,

units.source_text: 加之大城市五光十色的氛围，与伴随记忆恢复时的强烈刺激一道，深深地侵染了我的心。

en.t: and the bright, many-colored atmosphere of the great city, together with the strong stimulation that came as my memories revived, deeply colored my heart.

units.source_text: 每当看到走在街上的学生们的面孔，我便感受到对于新学年的希望与紧张。

en.t: Whenever I saw the faces of students walking in the streets, I felt the hope and tension of the new school year.
For a while, I forgot about Sensei.

units.source_text: 开学后，大约过了一个月，我的心情又松懈了下来，

en.t: After classes began and about a month had passed, my spirits slackened again,

units.source_text: 开始一脸欲求不满地在大街上转悠，

en.t: and I began wandering through the streets with a dissatisfied look on my face,

units.source_text: 想要得到什么似的环顾自己的房间。

en.t: looking around my own room as though I wanted something.

units.source_text: 我的脑海里再一次浮现出先生的面庞，

en.t: Sensei's face once again rose up in my mind,

units.source_text: 于是我又想去看望先生了。

en.t: and I wanted to go see him again.
